name: What maintenance is required for a Lazy Susan after installation?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for a Lazy Susan after installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lazy Susans generally require minimal maintenance. Regularly wipe down the shelves with a damp cloth and mild cleaner to keep them free of dust and spills. Periodically check the central pole or mounting hardware for any signs of loosening; gently tighten screws if necessary to maintain stability. For units with metal bearings or tracks, a light application of a silicone-based lubricant (avoiding petroleum-based products) can ensure continued smooth rotation, especially if you notice any squeaking or stiffness. Avoid overloading the shelves beyond their weight capacity to prevent warping or damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintain by cleaning shelves, checking hardware for tightness, and occasionally lubricating bearings. Avoid overloading to ensure smooth operation.
